entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: The primary non-profit organization developing and maintaining X3D standards.

entities.name: Naval Postgraduate School
entities.note: US military university hosting significant X3D research and the X3D-Edit tool.

entities.name: Virginia Tech
entities.note: University hosting the Advanced Research Computing group, heavily involved in X3D.

entities.name: Fraunhofer IGD
entities.note: German research institute where X3DOM was initially developed.

entities.name: Intelligraphics
entities.note: Consulting company led by Richard Puk, active in X3D standards.

entities.name: Kshell Analysis
entities.note: Consulting firm led by Vince Marchetti, contributing to X3D CAD working groups.

entities.name: Daly Realism
entities.note: Consulting firm led by Leonard Daly, active in X3D.

entities.name: NIST
entities.note: National Institute of Standards and Technology, historically involved in VRML/X3D standards.

entities.name: Web3D Korea
entities.note: Regional chapter of the Web3D Consortium promoting X3D in South Korea.

entities.name: Suwon University
entities.note: South Korean university involved in X3D research via Myeong Won Lee.

entities.name: Harvard University
entities.note: University where Andreas Plesch contributes to Web3D technologies.

entities.name: ISO/IEC JTC 1
entities.note: International standards body that ratifies X3D specifications.

entities.name: W3C
entities.note: World Wide Web Consortium, which collaborates with Web3D Consortium.

entities.name: Khronos Group
entities.note: Standards consortium for 3D graphics (glTF, WebGL) that collaborates with Web3D.

entities.name: Don Brutzman
entities.note: Co-chair of the X3D Working Group and researcher at Naval Postgraduate School.

entities.name: Nicholas Polys
entities.note: President of the Web3D Consortium and Director of Visual Computing at Virginia Tech.

entities.name: Anita Havele
entities.note: Executive Director of the Web3D Consortium.

entities.name: Richard Puk
entities.note: Co-chair of the X3D Working Group and President of Intelligraphics.

entities.name: Johannes Behr
entities.note: Original creator of X3DOM and researcher at Fraunhofer IGD.

entities.name: Michalis Kamburelis
entities.note: Lead developer of the Castle Game Engine and active Web3D Consortium member.

entities.name: Vince Marchetti
entities.note: Web3D Consortium board member and representative of Kshell Analysis.

entities.name: Leonard Daly
entities.note: Co-author of X3D books and President of Daly Realism.

entities.name: Sandy Ressler
entities.note: Former NIST researcher and long-time Web3D community contributor.

entities.name: Myeong Won Lee
entities.note: Professor at Suwon University and key figure in Web3D Korea.

entities.name: Roy Walmsley
entities.note: Web3D Consortium member and contributor to X3D specification editing.

entities.name: Andreas Plesch
entities.note: Researcher at Harvard University and active contributor to X3DOM and X3D standards.

entities.name: Holger Seelig
entities.note: Creator of the X_ITE X3D browser and active Web3D community member.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: The latest major version of the Extensible 3D Graphics standard.

entities.name: X3D 3.3
entities.note: The widely adopted previous version of the X3D standard.

entities.name: VRML
entities.note: Virtual Reality Modeling Language, the predecessor to X3D.

entities.name: X3DOM
entities.note: Open-source JavaScript framework for integrating X3D into HTML5.

entities.name: Castle Game Engine
entities.note: Cross-platform 3D and 2D game engine supporting X3D.

entities.name: X_ITE
entities.note: WebGL-based X3D browser created by Holger Seelig.

entities.name: X3D-Edit
entities.note: Authoring tool for X3D scenes maintained by NPS.

entities.name: Web3D Conference
entities.note: Annual international conference on 3D web technology.

entities.name: Extensible 3D (X3D) Graphics Working Group
entities.note: The primary working group within the Web3D Consortium responsible for the X3D spec.
